record.title: Inventory bounded uncompressed logical archives without extraction
record.intent: Recover reusable file-content evidence from preserved logical acquisitions.
requirements: Add typed read-only archive inventory to the existing evidence library with caller-pinned source digest and explicit byte member and aggregate limits.
Support a documented narrow uncompressed tar profile sufficient for preserved logical data archives; validate headers extents terminators and canonical member paths without extracting anything.
Accept regular files and directory entries while rejecting duplicate conflicting linked sparse extended or unsupported forms rather than silently normalizing them.
Return source digest and named content inventory or structural rejection; preserve original archives and do not claim ownership metadata or restoration fidelity.
acceptance: Independent synthetic controls and preserved archive comparisons pass without physical access.
